candidate_contract.new_sibling_reason: The source package ships all six as public target-prefixed executables; omitting any would preserve ambient-host behavior for that sibling.
candidate_contract.split_package_reason: The final GCC runtime dependency already names this package, and the aliases are alternate public names for the same payload rather than an independently versioned component.

lifecycle_proof_required: All 20 aliases are absent on a clean root before candidate installation.
All 20 aliases are relative links to package-owned Cygwin-prefixed siblings.
pacman -Qo reports the candidate package for every alias.
Removing the package removes all 20 aliases.
Installing baseline leaves all 20 aliases absent.
Reinstalling the candidate restores and owns all 20 aliases.
